hints.title: Minimal Repetition Lower Bound
hints.text: For b to be a substring of repeated a, the repeated string must have length at least len(b).

hints.title: Ceiling Multiplicity Repetition
hints.text: Repeat a minimum k times where k = ceil(len(b) / len(a)). If b is not in a*k, check a*(k+1) to cover boundary wrap-around.

hints.title: Two-Candidate Substring Check
hints.text: If b is in a*k, return k. If b is in a*(k+1), return k + 1. Otherwise, return minus 1.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.notes: Optimal solution achieving O(N + M) time and O(N + M) auxiliary space.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Unbounded while loops without an upper bound lead to time limit exceeded when b can never be matched.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Checking at most k and k + 1 repetitions tests all potential starting alignments in linear time.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should explain why testing at most k + 1 copies is sufficient.
